enchantments.tooltip: +7 Enhancement Bonus: +7 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Keen: Passive: The base critical threat range of this weapon is doubled. This does not stack with Improved Critical feat. Vorpal Strikes by this weapon also bypass all Fortification.
Entropic : An entropic weapon crackles with a sinister energy that seeks to unmake anything it contacts. When it strikes a target, they take an extra 2 to 12 points of untyped damage.
Life Stealing: This weapon has a chance to drain 1 to 3 levels from its target on a critical hit.
Vampirism: This weapon drains a tiny portion of the target's life force whenever it does damage.Note: provides 1d3 hp of healing per hit.

Nightmares: This weapon terrorizes your foes, applying a Mind Thrust effect on successful hits (dealing 5 to 40 force damage, Will vs. Enchantments negates) and exposing your foes to their greatest fears on vorpal hits, acting as a Phantasmal Killer spell.
This relic is attuned to heroic actions.

children.tooltip: Planar Conflux: When this item is equipped at the same time as a Planar Focus, you will gain set bonuses based on the Planar Focus that you have equipped.
